camp.mobilecamp.item_hint: Place to unfold. Sneak-use in the air to change modules.
camp.mobilecamp.already_deployed: You already have a C.A.M.P. in %s at %s, %s, %s. Pack it first.
camp.mobilecamp.blocked: C.A.M.P. needs clear 10×8 space, including its folding machinery. Obstruction at %s, %s, %s.
camp.mobilecamp.unloaded: C.A.M.P. site is outside loaded terrain or the world boundary at %s, %s, %s.
camp.mobilecamp.footing: No stable footing within three blocks at %s, %s, %s.
camp.mobilecamp.occupied: Clear the camp before changing modules or folding: a player or creature is still inside.
camp.mobilecamp.not_owner: Only this camp’s owner or an operator can operate its controls.
camp.mobilecamp.transforming: C.A.M.P. is transforming. Keep the interior clear.
camp.mobilecamp.wait_loaded: Move closer so the entire camp is loaded before folding.
camp.mobilecamp.attached: Attached equipment. Use the blue module control to change modules or the red switch to pack up.
camp.mobilecamp.no_sleep: This dimension is unsafe for sleeping. The bedroll stays protected.
camp.mobilecamp.editing: Close the module screen before packing the camp.
camp.mobilecamp.mechanism_blocked: A piston could not complete its stroke. Your C.A.M.P. has packed itself back up.
